children: TORONTO, Sept. 25, 2026 /CNW/ -- Pizza Pizza Royalty Corp. (the "Company") (
) today announced its monthly cash dividend of $0.0675 per share for September 2026.
The dividend will be payable to shareholders of record at the close of business September 29, 2026, and will be paid on October 15, 2026.
For tax purposes, the 2026 dividend will be considered a taxable eligible dividend.
